text: {"name":"rf_apply_mode_configuration","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Selects one of two RF mode values, conditionally clears the corresponding state bit, zeros a control register, and issues data and instruction barriers.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"mode_config_value","v1":"state_bit_mask"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":6,"meaning":"Status byte checked before clearing the selected state bit."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"32-bit control register written with zero."},{"offset":136,"meaning":"Destination for the selected mode configuration value (0x800 or 0x1000)."},{"offset":332,"meaning":"Flags word from which the selected bit is cleared."}]}
